participant_a_prompt_text: Your partner will tell you about a time when they felt you were too harsh or critical with them. Listen to their feelings and discuss how you can communicate with each other in a more supportive and constructive way.
participant_b_prompt_text: Recall a time when you teased or joked with your partner in a way that was hurtful or embarrassing to them. Describe the situation and why you think your behavior was unacceptable.
